sources.osm: OpenStreetMap, extract timestamp 2026-11-11T00:17:14Z; © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL. OSM.fr PBF cut covering the streamed window x=-2048..10240, y=-7168..8192. Not a LiDAR survey.
sources.dem: Copernicus GLO-30 (30 m DSM), resampled and building-masked to approximate bare earth. Not LiDAR, not a 0.5 m DTM.
sources.waterfront: Bund flood wall / promenade at 6.9 m Wusong (Shanghai Water Authority 2024; 1989–1993 Bund rebuild). Street ~3.2 m from the 1997 tide report. Not LiDAR.
sources.waibaidu: Schematic camelback truss from published span/width/height (zh/en Wikipedia); OSM centreline for placement.
sources.note: Shanghai 2025 government aerial / 0.1 m ortho / 0.5 m DSM is not publicly downloadable and was not used. Heights are OSM tags plus cited schematic overrides, not LiDAR.
sources.labels: Wikidata items in the AOI, ranked by zh+en Wikipedia page views (Nov 2025–Oct 2026). far distances follow scripts/labels.py.
